services.desc: With decades of experience, marine craftsmanship, and knowledge, Tidewater has developed into one of the fastest-growing and most popular brands in North America. Whether you're looking for a boat for fishing, water sports, or leisurely cruising, each Tidewater model is crafted with attention to detail, superior construction, and innovative features. Georgian Bay is known for its stunning beauty, but its conditions can vary greatly, with choppy waters and unpredictable weather. Tidewater Boats are perfectly suited for these environments, providing a stable, comfortable ride. blurb: Muskoka Marinas offers boat rentals including pontoons and deck boats with orientation for new boaters. They provide boat service including maintenance, detailing, winterizing, and mobile on-water service. Storage options with pickup and delivery are available for various lakes in the Muskoka region.
